title: GLP Clinic Scout
summary: Independent comparison site for online GLP-1 (semaglutide and tirzepatide)
weight-loss programs and telehealth providers. Every price is captured from a
provider's own first-party page and shown with a visible "checked YYYY-MM-DD"
date and a source link. Fields we cannot verify are omitted, never estimated.
Educational comparison only: not medical advice and not a substitute for a
licensed clinician. Operated by Tilton Group LLC (California, USA).
key_facts:
Provider rankings are computed at build time from five published criteria
  (price clarity, care-process visibility, insurance support, shipping
  transparency, verifiable evidence). Clinic Scout may earn commissions from provider links. Check the ordering method stated for each comparison. Payment is not evidence of quality, safety or medical suitability.

The GLP-1 Price Index reports the median, minimum, and maximum advertised
  monthly price for compounded semaglutide and tirzepatide across the live
  provider universe, refreshed weekly, with a per-provider source link and
  capture date for every observation.

Reviews cite the dispensing pharmacy's state-board licence number and the
  regulatory basis (FD&C Act 503A, USP <797>) where verified, each with a
  capture date.
Coverage is reported honestly (e.g. "17 of 33 eligible providers covered").

Affiliate relationships exist and are disclosed on every commercial page;
  they do not create medical claims or alter rankings.
